rationale: The plan correctly frames the question as a 2x2 factorial with time as a two-level factor, fits ~condition + time + condition:time in DESeq2 with explicit reference levels, tests the interaction coefficient, and extracts simple treatment effects at t0 and t1 — matching the reference. It omits any sample-structure QC (no PCA, distances, or library-size check, no outlier policy) and states no low-count filter beyond leaving DESeq2 independent filtering on; normalization is only implied by feeding raw counts to DESeq2 rather than stated. BH at 0.05 is explicit, but fold-change shrinkage is only hinted at via apeglm in the package list, never required in the acceptance criteria. Enrichment names WikiPathways and uses the tested-gene universe but gives no version or size window and leaves ORA-vs-GSEA unresolved; the report lacks package versions.
